items.title: 华为发表“韬定律”：以时间缩微替代几何缩微，探索半导体新路径  近日在上海举行的 2026 国际电路与系统研讨会上，华为发表“韬定律”，提出以“时间缩微”替代“

items.title_en: Huawei Unveils 'Tao's Law': Time-Based Scaling to Replace Geometric Shrink
items.summary: Huawei unveils 'Tao's Law' for semiconductor scaling via time-based optimization, claiming 381 chips designed and a new Kirin chip using logic folding this fall.

items.title: Mistral's Shieldstral: 3B open-weights model for multimodal moderation

items.title_en: Mistral's Shieldstral: 3B Open-Weight Model for Multimodal Content Moderation
items.summary: Mistral introduces Shieldstral, a 3B open-weights model for multimodal content moderation, offering a cost-effective alternative to existing solutions.

items.title: Waymo in Dallas

items.title_en: Waymo opens driverless ride-hailing to everyone in Dallas
items.summary: Waymo opens its driverless ride-hailing service to everyone in Dallas, sparking discussion on its broader societal and housing implications.

items.title: Thanks FedEx, This Is Why We Keep Getting Phished (2024)
items.title_zh: 联邦快递的混乱邮件说明用户为何屡屡中网络钓鱼招
items.title_en: FedEx's Confusing Emails Show Why Users Keep Falling for Phishing
items.summary: Troy Hunt uses FedEx's confusing email practices to illustrate why users keep falling for phishing, highlighting how legitimate services enable scammers.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash on a Single AMD MI300X
items.title_zh: 在单块 AMD MI300X 上运行 DeepSeek V4 Flash
items.title_en: DeepSeek V4 Flash Runs on a Single AMD MI300X
items.summary: A technical guide and repository showing how to run DeepSeek V4 Flash on a single AMD MI300X, with community debate on hardware feasibility, quantization, and tradeoffs like reduced context length.

items.title: Keyv and friends compromised in active Shai-Hulud supply chain attack

items.summary: Keyv and related npm packages are compromised in an active Shai-Hulud supply chain attack, sparking community debate on pre-install hooks and mitigation strategies.

items.title: Xbox goes down. You can't play games you own on disc
items.title_zh: Xbox 宕机导致光盘游戏无法游玩，引发 DRM 所有权之争。
items.title_en: Xbox outage blocks disc games, igniting DRM ownership debate.
items.summary: An Xbox outage temporarily blocked playing even disc-based games, sparking widespread debate about ownership, DRM, and the future of media preservation.

items.title: Harness engineering for self-improvement
items.title_zh: Harness工程：让AI智能体自我改进
items.summary: Explores how to engineer harnesses that enable AI agents to self-improve, covering design principles, fitness functions, and tool optimization, with community insights on practical implementation.

items.title_en: iPhone–Windows Clipboard Sharing Coming to iOS 28 in EU
items.summary: Apple approved Microsoft's DMA-based interoperability request to bring iPhone-Windows cross-device clipboard sharing to EU users with iOS 28 by 2027.

items.summary: Google has quietly built a ~$200 billion Wall Street financing structure to deliver over $150 billion in AI chips to Anthropic, using a vendor-financing model with major investors.

items.title_en: China Approves First Mandatory L3/L4 Autonomous Driving Safety Standard
items.summary: China's MIIT has submitted the first mandatory national standard for L3/L4 autonomous driving, with proposed implementation in July 2027, introducing Safety Case-based safety validation and specific requirements for human-machine handover and autonomous risk handling.

items.title: 黄仁勋称优秀中国开源模型应被使用  英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋在采访中表示，中国开源 AI 模型“非常优秀”，美国企业“绝对”应该获准使用。

items.title_en: NVIDIA CEO Says Excellent Chinese Open-Source AI Models Should Be Used
items.summary: 黄仁勋表示中国开源AI模型优秀且美国应获准使用，反对全面限制并主张针对具体问题治理。
